summary: Learn sustainable tourism development with GSTC, UN SDGs, and practical tools. Build scorecards, plans, and reporting templates in 5 days.
lede: Sustainable tourism development helps tourism and hospitality professionals plan tourism activity while balancing environmental impacts, community benefit and destination carrying capacity. This training supports practical decisions through impact assessment, stakeholder engagement and visitor-flow planning, with exercises in improving operations and building sustainability reports that track progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape tourism development, oversee visitor-facing operations, or support destination sustainability decisions. It is especially relevant if you need practical tools for managing impacts, coordinating communities, and reporting progress across tourism, hospitality, and destination systems.
audience: Operations Managers in lodges, resorts, and attractions
prerequisites: You should bring a working understanding of tourism or hospitality operations, plus familiarity with a destination, project, or service context you want to improve. A laptop is recommended for completing templates and scorecards, and any existing visitor data, sustainability reports, stakeholder lists, or project plans will make the exercises more relevant.
